What happens after an enquiry

A plain sequence. No response time is promised.

  1. You get in touch

    Send the form, call, or email. Say which course you are asking about, or say that you are not sure.

  2. The provider replies

    They use the contact method you chose. This demonstration does not promise a response time.

  3. You agree what to discuss

    The licence, the training and what you already hold. Nothing is confirmed until the provider has spoken to you.

  4. Directions follow later

    The street address is not published here. It is shared when training is being arranged.
